say:1:1741122001:1.text: I should probably turn down these banquet invitations...
say:1:1741122001:1.source_cn: 这些宴会的邀请，还是推掉吧……
say:1:1741122001:1.male: I should probably turn down these banquet invitations...
say:1:1741122001:1.female: I should probably turn down these banquet invitations...

say:2:1741122002:1.text: I know the noble ladies probably mean well... though I'm sure some of them are also hoping for a bit of royal gossip.
say:2:1741122002:1.source_cn: 虽然明白这些贵族小姐邀请我是出于好意……呃，可能也有想...
say:2:1741122002:1.male: I know the noble ladies probably mean well... though I'm sure some of them are also hoping for a bit of royal gossip.
say:2:1741122002:1.female: I know the noble ladies probably mean well... though I'm sure some of them are also hoping for a bit of royal gossip.

say:3:1741122003:1.text: But I'd rather work up a sweat on the training field than make small talk at a ball.
say:3:1741122003:1.source_cn: 但比起在舞会上应酬，还是在训练场上挥洒汗水来得痛快。
say:3:1741122003:1.male: But I'd rather work up a sweat on the training field than make small talk at a ball.
say:3:1741122003:1.female: But I'd rather work up a sweat on the training field than make small talk at a ball.

say:4:1741122004:1.text: Besides, those dresses are a nightmare. Tight waist, long skirt, heavy fabric... I can hardly breathe in them.
say:4:1741122004:1.source_cn: 而且，束腰，长裙摆，沉重的裙身……那些宴会礼服穿上之后...
say:4:1741122004:1.male: Besides, those dresses are a nightmare. Tight waist, long skirt, heavy fabric... I can hardly breathe in them.
say:4:1741122004:1.female: Besides, those dresses are a nightmare. Tight waist, long skirt, heavy fabric... I can hardly breathe in them.

say:5:1741122005:1.text: Peggy must have gotten a stack of invitations too. Poor thing's probably got a headache just looking at them.
say:5:1741122005:1.source_cn: 佩吉那边估计也收到了不少邀请吧。估计她得为此头疼一阵子了。
say:5:1741122005:1.male: Peggy must have gotten a stack of invitations too. Poor thing's probably got a headache just looking at them.
say:5:1741122005:1.female: Peggy must have gotten a stack of invitations too. Poor thing's probably got a headache just looking at them.
